title: Fighting Numerical Hallucinations via Data-centric Compilation for Online Financial QA
authors: Hao Chen; Xing Tang; Qirui Liu; Weijie Shi; Shiwei Li; Fuyuan Lyu; Weihong Luo; Xiku Du; Xiuqiang He
why_relevant: Proposes a data-centric RAG framework targeting noise sensitivity and hallucination in financial numerical QA via adversarial noise injection and verifiable program synthesis, directly addressing robustness to noisy/conflicting retrieved evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (financial numerical QA); robustness contributions are application-tied rather than general.
